acceptance.endpoint_noise: Small endpoint wins do not establish broad performance. Endpoint guard is nonregression; primary claim is the frozen local full-corpus packing measurement.
acceptance.ratio_calculation: sum integer process CPU nanoseconds over all96 original versus all96 candidate in each repeat; candidate_total*10 <= original_total*9; never pool or select per-instance ratios

analysis_outputs.limits: Only a local exposed optimization can be considered; original8-entry baseline, repaired96 validation and unsuccessful heapv2 summaries remain unchanged.
analysis_outputs.native_raw_evidence: all640 declared campaign cells if execution finishes, each with model/proof/checker/process/stdout/stderr/stats/profile artifacts as applicable; lossless storage receipts
analysis_outputs.packing_raw_evidence: every pair config, process/logs, phase events, each returned arm timing/byte identity, final pair/terminal receipt; no raw timing samples discarded
analysis_outputs.source_evidence: both complete snapshots, original/candidate source maps/tars, same native library/build receipt, executable/controller/helper identities
analysis_outputs.unit_raw_ABI_bytes: base64 in per-fixture unit probe receipts

candidate.exact_transform: The controller OLD_PACK and NEW_PACK string literals and insertion of from array import array define the complete prospective change; require exactly one matching old function and one import ctypes before applying. No other source difference is allowed.
candidate.ownership: Returned ctypes views retain writable buffer owners through the synchronous native ABI; no from_address or _objects mutation.
candidate.representation: native-endian array i literals and Q offsets; ctypes from_buffer views only after all appends; empty literal buffer uses the existing zero-length ctypes array; itemsize mismatch takes the original list/splat path over the already canonical tuple.

failure_policy.ordinary_native_TIMEOUT_or_UNKNOWN: Retain all endpoint penalties; continue declared grid. Missing fixed-budget trace blocks equivalence.
failure_policy.ordinary_packing_timeout_or_exception: Retain process, journals and both planned identities; continue the entire packing grid, block eligibility. Unstarted second arm remains NOT_RUN, not an attempted measurement.
failure_policy.parent_interruption: Retain partial stdout/stats/journals/processes even without final cell rows; execution-accounting reconciles all planned directories and records malformed/truncated metadata; independent final file inventory is attempted.
failure_policy.retry: No resume or overwrite. Any interrupted attempt has its own complete preserved evidence path and is reported separately; no automatic rerun.
failure_policy.unsafe_prerequisite_ABI_byte_identity_or: Stop after current declared phase where safe, retain abort receipt and explicit remaining NOT_RUN identities; never claim completed full study.

implementation.helper_scope: heap_reference.py is a byte-identical pinned utility/reference module; its heap build/run/gate entry points are never called by this study.
implementation.public_reconstruction: For each file, base64-decode zlib_base64, zlib-decompress, require exact byte count and SHA-256, and write using exclusive creation. The controller checks the public payloads against local source before execution; copied output implementation files are checked before candidate creation, around every unit/corpus/native phase, and by read-only report replay. No candidate payload is pre-created or imported.

fixed32.selection: unchanged original outcome-blind structural size-quantile subset, unchanged instance order

full96.public_reconstruction: Read public wrapper JSON, select object ["inventory"], serialize json.dumps(object,sort_keys=True,indent=2)+"\n" as UTF-8; reconstructed bytes must have the declared inventory SHA-256. The wrapper file has its separately pinned public_file_sha256.

byte_probes.output: direct comparison result plus per-arm byte hashes/counts and complete source identities; input and frozen code allow reconstruction

endpoint.one_timeout: retained completion gain/loss or return difference; not a conflicting answer; full PAR-2 included
endpoint.profile: same admission+replay, runtime initialization, full pack, native ABI, decode instrumentation for both arms; partial phase journal survives timeout; ABI includes construction/normalization/search/result encoding, not pure CDCL search

fixture_scope: exact integer rejection including bool and __index__ object
separately forced literal and offset width fallback
GC plus allocation churn after pack returns, then actual ABI call
independent SAT model and DRUP proof validation for small known-answer ABI fixtures

packing.automatic_gc: left enabled identically; gc.collect outside clock before each arm
packing.primary_scope: one complete _pack_cnf call, including unchanged canonical_cnf; return value retained until both stop clocks are taken
packing.shared_process_between_paired_calls: separate module namespaces; same unchanged canonical_cnf dependency; release first result before second timing, collect GC before each call; order balanced prospectively

closed_findings.finding: Mandatory unit probe summaries were not bound to their frozen arm configuration and actual process/log identities.
closed_findings.fix: Both initial prerequisite gating and final summary require exact arm configuration, interpreter/controller command and cwd, successful in-deadline process, complete content-bound stdout/stderr, the exact 17 names, and matching per-probe PASS receipts.

closed_findings.finding: Copied output controller/helper/tests were not compared with prospective implementation hashes after copying or during replay.
closed_findings.fix: Require exact copied byte sizes and SHA-256 against embedded public payloads before candidate creation, around unit/corpus/native phases, at final guards, and during read-only report replay.

unchanged_scientific_scope: same repaired native binary and source pins
all required equivalence and endpoint PAR-2 gates
prior negative evidence and roadmap gates

publication_gate.prerequisite_verification: Hash-bound completed fresh-check and assembled-result receipts plus retained acquired compressed sources; original raw archive may already be durably preserved and retired.

resources.cpu: one explicitly selected allowed CPU other than0

schedule.arm_order_rule: original,candidate when (instance_index + repeat_index) modulo2 is0; candidate,original otherwise. Native runner rotates each declared two-arm field by instance index; field order by repeat is O,C then C,O then O,C. Thus each96 repeat has48 original-first and48 candidate-first cases; each case has its prospectively fixed alternating order.
phase_order: read-only archive replay and final report
schedule.source_instance_order: full96 byte/micro/endpoint phases use exact original96 order; fixed32 uses its unchanged frozen order

workload_expectation.rough_elapsed_minutes: about60-90 on this host, not a deadline or censoring rule; worst declared ancillary process limits permit longer
